findings.title: Nested timeout creates an owned step process group omitted by runner-PG-only supervision
findings.evidence: Runner calls nonforeground timeout; static actual uutils binary contains default setpgid(0,0); census and signals select runner group only
findings.counterexample: Command exits leaving a child in timeout PGID T; runner-PG census R reports empty. On outer KILL of R, T can continue while lock FD closes.
findings.minimal_closure: Align launch and verified ownership boundary or track all owned step groups; hold lock through actual cleanup; add control through real nested wrapper.

findings.title: Shell true/false substitution causes undefined Python names during supervisor JSON publication
findings.evidence: Unquoted heredoc embeds timed_out:$TIMED_OUT into Python dictionary; true/false are undefined; json.dump never reached
findings.counterexample: Normal false or timeout true both cause NameError; validator then sets FAILED_PUBLICATION/exit7, no intended receipt
findings.minimal_closure: Pass Boolean through quoted/data-safe interface; retain causal timeout/interruption and publication errors independently.

findings.title: Delayed post-launch PID lookup loses fast exits and an unconditional wait can defeat supervision
findings.evidence: Sleep0.2 precedes ps/pgrep identity lookup; missing group exits73 before supervisor record; wait RPID precedes final survivor classification with no deadline
findings.counterexample: C2/C3 finish before ps; C2 orphan is reparented and cannot be found via pgrep-P old PID
findings.minimal_closure: Ownership handshake before workload exit/orphaning; retained identity; bounded termination confirmation and supervisor record on refusal/survivors.

findings.title: Primary failure attribution can be replaced by cleanup; failed expected-negative sign can exit0
findings.evidence: block cleanup/source precedes block command rc; wrong S45 rc0 becomes FIRST_FAIL_RC0 and FAILED case exits0
findings.counterexample: Command exit1 plus cleanup failure records96 as first failure; S45 unexpected0 latchesFAILED but runner exits0
findings.minimal_closure: Preserve command outcome before cleanup; retain raw0 observation but choose nonzero validation-failure exit; keep cleanup separate.

findings.title: Control defaults exceed aggregate60-second mandate on unexpected hang
findings.evidence: C2/C3 outer30 plus default grace45 is75 before extra reaping/publication; no aggregate supervisor
findings.counterexample: One unexpectedly hung C2 consumes more than whole allowed control bundle
findings.minimal_closure: Explicit bounded control/grace values and aggregate sequential bound including failure cleanup; first unexpected result stops.

control_dispositions.C1: Same-group control bypasses real step(); publication defect prevents intended TIMEOUT receipt
control_dispositions.C2: Fast-exit ownership race can miss orphan and refuse73 before record
control_dispositions.C3: Fast-exit race; exit7 can arise for wrong cause from undefined Python Boolean, so inspect exact facts not exit alone
control_dispositions.C4: Token check statically refuses71 when launch env absent; control wrapper reports success by exiting0

runtime_claims: NONE; all counterexamples are static code/control-flow analysis, not observed process leaks or executions
